name: Echeyakee
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats.  He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth.  And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.

You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee.  His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo

Go.  Blow this horn when you reach his lair.  Blow the horn, and he will come.
narrative.objectives: Bring Echeyakee's Hide to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

Your path is still long, Champion. Let's hope you stride it well.
narrative.requestItemsText: The great cat calls to you, adventurer.

quests.name: The Hunter's Way
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Sergra Darkthorn

quests.objectiveText: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Ishamuhale
